//: Straight-line ABS stop on dry asphalt (high mu surface).
//1: What automotive validation calls a 'high-mu stop' or 'dry-pavement
//2: stop' — friction is already near its limit, so ABS gives only a
//3: small stopping-distance improvement.  The headline benefit is
//4: vehicle stability under braking, not raw stopping distance.
name: abs_high_mu_stop

events.//: No launch. config/abs_high_mu.json spawns the car rolling at
events.//1: 27.7 m/s (spawn.speed_mps), and it coasts through the key-on and
events.//2: shift above; the KEY OFF brake clamp is skipped for a rolling
events.//3: start, so nothing drags it before the RSA reports RUN.  It used to
events.//4: ramp the throttle from rest, wait_for_speed 30 m/s (released at
events.//5: 15.03 s), then coast to an 18.00 s brake: 18 s of sim time to set
events.//6: up a 3 s stop.  The brake now lands at 3.04 s at 25.77 m/s, against
events.//7: 25.73 m/s on the old schedule; brake value and hold are unchanged.
events.//8: Measured 2026-10-08 against the existing baselines: stop 36.84 m
events.//9: (captured 36.94), every gating rule green, wall time 96 s vs 152 s.
